Name: Cheaper (Big) Chests
Author: weissnicht01
Description:
Are you an item horder? Do you lack the resources required to continue hording? Then this mod is right for you!

_____________

Changes the amount of wood required to craft (big) chests and the amount of stone required to craft (big) stone chests.
The amount of copper ingots required to craft big chests can also be changed.
All of these values are customisable in the config.
If you want to change them in-game, use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]

_____________

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Requires game version 1.6
